@@U03700@@
Give us all you have to give,
Kiss and caress this love-starved lad,
We've never had such a life to live,
It’s the best time we've ever had!

@@U03701@@
(伽拉忒亚 approaches in her seashell chariot.)

@@U03703@@
Oh, my dear, it’s you!

@@U03705@@
Oh, father! What joy to see you!
Linger awhile, you dolphins!
The sight of him enthralls me!

@@U03707@@
Past, gone past already,
in the circling motion of dolphins!
But what do they know of the heart’s longing?
If only I could sail with them!
But a single look delights me the yearlong.

@@U03709@@
Hail! Hail!
And hail again!
How full my heart is with joy!
How Beauty and Truth possess me!
Water gave birth to all of life!
All of life was cradled in water!
Ocean,
I pray you prevail forever!
For if you had not send clouds,
if you had not lavished on us brooks,
if you had not sent streams twisting this way and that,
and great rivers,
winding, winding,
if you did not—
translation:
@@U03700@@
给我们你所能给予的一切，
亲吻和爱抚这个渴望爱情的小伙子，
我们从来没有过过这样的生活
这是我们度过的最美好的时光！

@@U03701@@
（伽拉忒亚驾着她的贝壳战车走来。）

@@U03703@@
噢，亲爱的，是你！

@@U03705@@
噢，父亲！见到你真是太高兴了！
你们这些海豚，再呆一会儿吧！
看到他就让我着迷！

@@U03707@@
过去了，已经过去了，
在海豚的盘旋运动中！
但他们又知道什么是内心的渴望呢？
如果我能和他们一起航行就好了！
但一整年都让我高兴。

@@U03709@@
万岁！冰雹！
再次冰雹！
我的心多么充满喜乐啊！
美和真理多么让我着迷！
水孕育了一切生命！
所有的生命都孕育在水中！
海洋，
祈愿你永远胜利！
因为如果你没有送出云彩，
如果你没有在我们布鲁克斯身上挥霍，
如果你没有送出蜿蜒曲折的溪流，
和伟大的河流，
缠绕，缠绕，
如果你没有——
